transcript.en: Oh, Ben.
I just remembered I never filled in that form for Nick - did you do it?
transcript.zh: 我刚想起来我还没给尼克填表呢，你填了吗，

transcript.en: The course feedback form?
Yes.
If you want, we can do it together, I've got mine here.
transcript.zh: 如果你愿意，我们可以一起做，我带来我的了，

transcript.en: Is that OK?
Yeah.
OK, let's have a look then.
What do we have to do?
Let's fill in the top first, let's see, Course, Course code ...
transcript.zh: 让我们先从头开始，让我看看，课程代码……

transcript.en: Er, it's Communication in Business.
OK, Communication ...in ...Business, I do know that, but what's the code?
transcript.zh: 好的，商务交流，我知道这个，但是代码是什么...

transcript.en: CB16 something, CB162, isn't it?
Mmm, that's it, OK and dates, when did we start?
transcript.zh: 就是它，好的，时间呢，我们什么时候开始上的？

transcript.en: I remember, my birthday's on May 4th and it was the day after, it must have been May 5th.
transcript.zh: 我记得我的生日是5月4日，一天后开课了，肯定是5月5日。

transcript.en: Gosh, doesn't seem that long ago, does it?
transcript.zh: 天啊，好像是刚发生不久的事，不是吗？

transcript.en: No, and we finish at the end of this week, on Friday, so that's July 15th?
transcript.zh: 是的，我们在这周的周五刚结课，7月15日？

transcript.en: Er 16th, Monday was the 12th.
Right, that was the easy bit, now let's have a look - "Please give your comments on the following aspects of the course", OK, what's the first one?
transcript.zh: 好的，很简单。现在让我们看看。请就如下几个方面给出课程评价。好的，第一个是什么？

transcript.en: Oh, course organisation.
What do you think?
Er, clear?
It was, wasn't it?
Yes, I think the organisation was clear.
transcript.zh: 是的，我觉得设置的很清楚。

transcript.en: OK, anything else for course organisation?
It was a good thing he gave us the course outline at the beginning, in the first session, that was useful, so I'll put that down, shall I?
transcript.zh: 好事情是他在第一学期发教学大纲给我们，那很有用，我把这个写下来，好吗？

transcript.en: Now, going on to suggestions for improvement, one thing that wasn't so good, I think we could have done a bit more work at the beginning, I mean at the beginning it seemed dead easy.
transcript.zh: 现在是改进的意见。有一件事不是很好。我认为我们本该在一开始多做点儿作业，我的意思是开始的课程似乎很容易。

transcript.en: Yeah.
I thought it was going to be really easy and then all of a sudden in the second half of the course we got a whole load of work, reading to do and essays and things.
transcript.zh: 我以为会很简单，之后突然间，后半部分课程的作业量、读书量和论文量太大了。

transcript.en: Yes, it'd be better if it was more even.
transcript.zh: 对的，量能平均一些更好。

transcript.en: OK, now course delivery, does that mean teaching?
transcript.zh: 好的，课程交付，是指教学吗？

transcript.en: Yeah, I suppose so.
Well, what I thought was really good on this course was the standard of teaching.
transcript.zh: 我认为这门课的优点是教学标准。

transcript.en: Actually, I mean some of the teachers were better than others - but the standard generally was fine.
transcript.zh: 事实上，我的意思是虽然有些老师比其他人更好，但是整体水平很好。

transcript.en: Much better than other courses I've been on.
transcript.zh: 比我上过的其他课程都好。

transcript.en: Yeah, I agree.
Let's put that then.
What about suggestions for improvement?
I...I didn't think it was all that wonderful when we had great long group discussion sessions that went on for hours and hours.
transcript.zh: 我不喜欢我们总是没完没了的进行长篇小组讨论会。是的。

transcript.en: I don't mean we shouldn't have group discussions, just that they shouldn't go on too long.
transcript.zh: 我不是说我们不该有小组讨论，但是不该那么长时间。

transcript.en: Now, on to materials and equipment.
Oh, now what was good about some sessions was the handouts.
transcript.zh: 好的地方是有些课程有讲义。

transcript.en: Yes, I thought all the handouts were good actually, and some were great, with website addresses and everything.
transcript.zh: 是的，事实上，我觉得所有的讲义都很好，还有一些真是棒极了，还有网址等等。

transcript.en: One problem though with materials was the key texts.
transcript.zh: 关于材料的一个问题是出自关键文本上。

transcript.en: Yes!
There just weren't enough copies on reserve in the library.
transcript.zh: 图书馆没有足够的副本。

transcript.en: And if you can't get the key texts before the session, how are you supposed to do the reading?
transcript.zh: 如果你不能在上课前拿到关键文本，你该怎么完成阅读？是的。

transcript.en: And not enough computers.
transcript.zh: 另外没有足够多的电脑

transcript.en: You have to wait ages to get one.
OK, testing and evaluation - well, I don't know, it's hard to say until we've got our written assignments back.
transcript.zh: 好的，测试与评估，我不知道，在我们拿回书面作业前，这个还很难说。

transcript.en: Don't talk about it, I only got mine in yesterday, it was a real struggle.
transcript.zh: 别提了，我昨天只拿到了我的成绩，这真纠结。

transcript.en: I hate to think what mark I'll get.
transcript.zh: 我不想再想起我得到的分数了。

transcript.en: Yes, but at least we've done the oral presentation - I thought that was good, the way I got my feedback really quickly.
transcript.zh: 好的，但是至少我们做了口头报告，我认为这很好，我很快就得到了反馈。

transcript.en: Yes, it was.
And I liked the way we knew what we'd be evaluated on, we knew the criteria, so we knew we had to think about clarity, organisation, and so on.
transcript.zh: 我喜欢这种清楚的评估方式。我们知道标准，所以我们得考虑清晰性、结构等等。

transcript.en: Yeah, but I'm not so sure about the written work.
transcript.zh: 是的，但是我对书面作业不确定。

transcript.en: One thing I think is that there's just too much, it's really stressful.
transcript.zh: 我觉得要做的事情太多了，压力很大。

transcript.en: Yes, I'd agree and I don't see why they can't let us know the criteria they use for marking.
transcript.zh: 是的，我同意，而且我不知道为什么他们不告诉我们评分的标准是什么。

transcript.en: The written assignments?
But he told us.
No, for the final exams.
What are they looking for - what are the criteria?
transcript.zh: 他们想要什么，标准是什么？

transcript.en: What makes a pass or a fail?
transcript.zh: 通过与不及格是如何定义的

transcript.en: Yeah, I never thought of that.
It'd be really useful.
OK, any other comments?
I thought student support, was excellent.
Yeah, me too.
OK, excellent.
Other comments?
No, I can't think of anything else.
transcript.zh: 没了，我想不起来别的了。

transcript.en: Nor me.
OK, so that's done.
Thanks, Ben.
No, thank you.
